#include <iostream>

#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

struct FlowEdge {
    int from, to, capacity, reverse;
    FlowEdge(int f, int t, int c, int r) : from(f), to(t), capacity(c), reverse(r) {}
};

vector<FlowEdge> edges;
vector<vector<int>> adjList;

int computeMaxFlow(int src, int dst) {
    int flow = 0;
    while (true) {
        vector<int> parent(edges.size(), -1);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(src);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int i = 0; i < adjList[u].size(); ++i) {
                int e = adjList[u][i];
                int v = edges[e].to;
                if (edges[e].capacity == 0 || parent[v] >= 0) continue;
                q.push(v);
                parent[v] = e;
            }
        }
        if (parent[dst] < 0) break;
        int minCap = INT_MAX;
        for (int cur = dst; cur != src; cur = edges[parent[cur]].from)
            minCap = min(minCap, edges[parent[cur]].capacity);
        for (int cur = dst; cur != src; cur = edges[parent[cur]].from) {
            edges[parent[cur]].capacity -= minCap;
            edges[edges[parent[cur]].reverse].capacity += minCap;
        }
        flow += minCap;
    }
    return flow;
}

void connect(int u, int v, int cap, bool directed = true) {
    edges.emplace_back(u, v, cap, edges.size() + 1);
    adjList[u].push_back(edges.size() - 1);
    edges.emplace_back(v, u, directed ? 0 : cap, edges.size() - 2);
    adjList[v].push_back(edges.size() - 1);
}

const int MAX_SIZE = 11;

int scientists[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
int capsules[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
int infectionTime[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
const int dX[4] = {1, -1, 0, 0};
const int dY[4] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

void computeInfectionTimes() {
    queue<pair<int, int>> q;
    for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] == 'R') {
                infectionTime[i][j] = 0;
                q.push({i, j});
            } else {
                infectionTime[i][j] = INT_MAX;
            }
        }
    }
    
    while (!q.empty()) {
        auto [x, y] = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; ++dir) {
            int nx = x + dX[dir], ny = y + dY[dir];
            if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < gridSize && ny < gridSize && grid[nx][ny] != 'R') {
                if (infectionTime[nx][ny] > infectionTime[x][y] + 1) {
                    infectionTime[nx][ny] = infectionTime[x][y] + 1;
                    q.push({nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int encode(int x, int y) { return x * gridSize + y; }

    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> gridSize >> timeLimit;

        }

    adjList.assign(gridSize * gridSize * 2 + 2, vector<int>());

    for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) {

            if (grid[i][j] == 'R') {

    // Connect each lab to sink if it has capsules

        for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] == 'L' && capsules[i][j] > 0) {
                connect(encode(i, j), sink, capsules[i][j], true);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Connect labs to adjacent labs if reachable in time
    for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] == 'L') {
                for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; ++dir) {
                    int nx = i + dX[dir], ny = j + dY[dir];
                    if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < gridSize && ny < gridSize && grid[nx][ny] == 'L') {
                        if (infectionTime[nx][ny] > infectionTime[i][j] + 1) {
                            connect(encode(i, j), encode(nx, ny), INT_MAX, true);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Connect reactors to adjacent labs if reachable in time
    for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] == 'R') {
                for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; ++dir) {

                    if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < gridSize && ny < gridSize && grid[nx][ny] == 'L') {

                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << computeMaxFlow(source, sink) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
